title: Run script AFTER elements exist
when: ALWAYS — the most common cause of a black/blank preview is a <script> that runs getElementById before the element is parsed, returning null.
code:
<!-- WRONG: script runs before <canvas> exists -> getElementById returns null -> crash -->
<!-- RIGHT: put <script> at the END of <body>, after the elements, OR wrap in DOMContentLoaded -->
<body>
  <canvas id="c" width="400" height="400"></canvas>
  <script>
    // canvas is guaranteed to exist here
    const cv = document.getElementById('c');
    const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  </script>
</body>
<!-- If the script must live in <head>, wrap it:
     document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { ...all init... }); -->

title: Crisp responsive canvas (devicePixelRatio)
when: Any 2D canvas drawing. Avoids blurry rendering on retina and sizes to a square.

title: Fixed-timestep game loop (update/draw split)
when: Any game or animation. Separates UPDATE (logic) from DRAW (render) and steps logic at a fixed rate so speed is frame-rate independent. You MUST call start().

title: Arrow/WASD direction with no-reverse guard
when: Grid/direction games. Reads arrows + WASD, prevents 180-degree reversals, and stops the page from scrolling on arrow keys.

title: Spawn food on a random empty grid cell
when: Grid games that place items avoiding occupied cells. Never spawns on the snake.

title: Game-over overlay with restart
when: End-of-game UX. Draws a dim overlay with score and restarts on key/click.

title: Pleasant dark game palette
when: Use instead of pure black/blue defaults. Cohesive, modern, high-contrast.
